title: Installing Sanitary Tees Horizontally
description: A frequent mistake in waste pipe installation is using a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal-to-horizontal drainage run. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for transitions from horizontal to vertical drops or vertical stacks where gravity assists the directional flow. When placed horizontally, the sharp sweep restricts solid waste movement, leading to frequent clogs, sluggish drainage, and potential back-ups. To ensure smooth flow and maintain compliance with standard plumbing codes, professional installers always use a long-sweep combination wye and eighth bend or a standard wye fitting for horizontal drainage transitions.
